# Skip Retyping Product Reference

A consolidated plain-text reference for the current Skip Retyping product, pricing, privacy boundaries, support routes, and regional pages.

Last updated: 2026-08-25

## Product Summary

Skip Retyping is a private browser form autofill extension from Stealthy Apps. It saves reusable profiles in your browser and fills repeated job applications, signup forms, intake pages, demo requests, onboarding forms, support forms, vendor forms, internal admin forms, and business workflows.

Canonical product page: https://stealthyapps.com/skip-retyping/

## Core Features

- Profiles saved in your browser.
- Three saved profiles on the free plan.
- On-page profile picker.
- Fill Page action.
- Smart rules and custom fields.
- Right-click field capture.
- File upload matching for resumes, CVs, cover letters, portfolios, business documents, CSV files, and spreadsheets.
- Undo last fill.
- Export is free. Pro adds backup import and profile duplication.
- Field-learning suggestions.
- Support for the form pieces browser autofill often misses: dropdowns, custom selects, comboboxes, radio groups, checkboxes, textareas, upload fields, segmented phone fields, split birthdays, country/state/month aliases, middle names, pronouns, multilingual contact labels, embedded same-page sections, and fields that appear after the page loads.

## Best Fit

- Job applications and applicant profiles.
- Customer intake and onboarding forms.
- Demo requests and vendor signups.
- Support forms and profile pages.
- Internal admin forms and QA test profiles.
- Repeated business forms that ask for the same details again and again.

## Where Skip Retyping Fits

Skip Retyping is designed for structured profile data across many unrelated web forms.

- Browser autofill and password managers are usually strongest for saved addresses, sign-ins, and payment flows.
- Text expanders are usually strongest for snippets, notes, outreach, and canned replies.
- Macro and record-mode tools are usually strongest for selector scripts, repeated clicks, and browser automation.
- Record-mode form fillers are usually strongest when one exact form repeats the same way every time.
- Skip Retyping is strongest for repeated profile fields, custom labels, dropdowns, checkboxes, textareas, upload matching, smart rules, and review-before-submit filling.

## Pricing

- Free: three saved profiles, in-browser filling, on-page picker, smart rules, custom fields, upload matching, right-click capture, and undo.
- Pro monthly: $3.99/month.
- Pro yearly: $29.99/year.
- Pro lifetime: $39.99 once.

- Pro license and plan status: ExtensionPay.
- Checkout and payment processing: Stripe.

## Privacy

Skip Retyping stores profiles locally without a cloud profile account. Filling makes entered values and files available to the destination website, which may read or autosave them before submission. Undo cannot retract data already received. Exports and manual support messages may also contain selected profile data.

Pro license and plan status is checked through ExtensionPay. Stripe handles checkout and payment details. Neither service receives saved profile values from Skip Retyping. Support messages live in email systems and can be deleted on request.

Skip Retyping is built for repeated profile-style form fields around sign-in, checkout, account, and intake flows. Password managers, browser autofill, payment wallets, and site controls should keep handling the sensitive parts they are built for.

## Support

Smart Rules guide: https://stealthyapps.com/skip-retyping/docs/smart-rules/

Skip Retyping support covers setup, form filling issues, billing, privacy, and safe site reports.
The getting started guide is https://stealthyapps.com/skip-retyping/docs/getting-started/.

Best report:

- Page type or website.
- Field label or field type.
- What Skip Retyping did.
- What should have happened.
- Browser and Skip Retyping version if known.

Leave passwords, payment cards, CVCs, government IDs, tax IDs, one-time codes, customer records, and saved profile values out of support messages.

## Focused Search Pages

Job application autofill:
Skip Retyping helps with repeated job application fields such as contact details, work links, resume files, portfolio links, cover letters, availability, and profile answers. It fills from a saved profile and leaves the final submit to the user.

Resume upload autofill:
Skip Retyping stores upload references inside saved profiles and can match resumes, CVs, cover letters, portfolio files, documents, CSV files, and spreadsheets to reachable upload fields.

Local form autofill:
Skip Retyping keeps profiles in its browser storage. The normal Fill Page action works on the page the user chooses, while the optional floating button asks for current-site access only.

Browser autofill vs Skip Retyping:
Browser autofill is strongest for saved addresses and browser-managed payment flows. Skip Retyping is strongest for repeated profile data, custom fields, smart rules, upload matching, and long review-before-submit forms.
